Ultimate quickhack · DV14 · Cooldown 1 hour · 2 slots

For 3 Rounds they attack the nearest person (GM's choice) with whatever they hold. Then they take 2d6 Humanity Loss. At EMP 0 they don't stop.

Interface + 1d10 vs DV14. 10,000eb (Super Luxury). Cyberpunk: The Unification Era, Core Rules Chapter 10.
